title: 第9章 猫团管理与地脉感应第10章 猫薄荷丰收与系统奖励
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
林墨那一声带着威严与诱惑的咆哮，如同投入沸腾油锅的冷水，瞬间让围拢的猫群炸开了锅！
“喵？！”
（工作？！
“嗷呜？”
（换草？！
“嘶——！”
（地盘是他的？！
几十双猫眼中闪烁着惊疑、困惑、渴望，还有被“工作”
这个词激起的本能抗拒。
那只脸上带疤的灰猫（林墨暗称它“疤面”
）幽绿的瞳孔猛地收缩，喉咙里发出更加低沉凶戾的咆哮：“喵嗷——！”
（凭什么听你的？！
抢！
它作势就要扑向最近的几株猫薄荷嫩芽！
其他几只同样凶悍、饿极了的猫也蠢蠢欲动！
“铁爪！
钢爪！
挡下它！”
林墨心念急转，用猫语厉声喝道！
同时，他身体猛地前冲，并非攻击疤面，而是扑向距离疤面最近的一株猫薄荷，五指成爪，淡金色的爪芒瞬间覆盖指尖，作势就要狠狠抓向那脆弱的嫩叶！

“喵嗷——！”
（住手！
）疤面惊怒交加，硬生生刹住扑势！
它万万没想到这个“同类”
如此狠绝，宁愿毁掉也不让它们轻易得到！
林墨的爪子悬停在嫩叶上方一寸，眼神冰冷地扫视着躁动的猫群：“喵嗷呜！”
（谁动，草就没了！
想抢？除非把我撕碎！
但在这之前，我会毁掉所有草！
你们，什么也得不到！
他的话语配合着那随时可能落下的、闪烁着危险金芒的利爪，以及踏雪（白爪黑猫）、钢爪（黄狸花猫）同时发出的、充满战意的低吼，形成了一种强大的威慑！
躁动的猫群被镇住了。
尤其是疤面，幽绿的眼睛死死盯着林墨悬在嫩叶上的爪子，充满了不甘和忌惮。
它能感觉到，这个“同类”
说的是真的！
那股狠劲，比饥饿的野兽更甚！
混乱的场面暂时被压制。
林墨知道，光靠威慑远远不够，必须立刻给出胡萝卜！
他缓缓收回爪子，但姿态依旧紧绷，目光扫过猫群，声音放得稍微“温和”
content_en:
Lin Mo's majestic and seductive roar was like cold water thrown into a boiling oil pan, causing the surrounding cats to explode in an instant!
"Meow?!"
(Work?!
"Ouch?"
(Change grass?!
"Hiss——!"
(The territory is his?!
Dozens of pairs of cat eyes flashed with surprise, confusion, desire, and being "worked"
The visceral resistance the word evokes.
The gray cat with the scar on its face (Lin Mo secretly called it "scar face")
) The green pupils shrank suddenly, and a deeper and more ferocious roar came from his throat: "Meow--!"
(Why should I listen to you?!
Grab it!
It's about to pounce on the nearest few catnip buds!
Several other equally fierce and hungry cats are also ready to attack!
"Iron Claw!
Steel claw!
Block it! "
Lin Mo's thoughts changed quickly and he shouted in cat language!
At the same time, he rushed forward, not to attack Scarface, but to pounce on the catnip plant closest to Scarface. His five fingers formed claws, and the pale golden claws instantly covered his fingertips, as if he was going to claw hard at the fragile young leaves!
"Meow-!"
(Stop!
) Scarface was shocked and angry, and stopped his attack abruptly!
It never expected that this "similar"
So ruthless, I would rather destroy them than let them get it easily!
Lin Mo's paws hovered an inch above the young leaves, and his cold eyes scanned the restless cats: "Meow!"
(If anyone moves, the grass will be gone!
Want to grab it? Unless you tear me apart!
But before that, I will destroy all the grass!
You get nothing!
His words combined with the sharp claws that could fall at any time and flashed with dangerous golden light, as well as the simultaneous low roars full of fighting spirit from Taxue (black cat with white claws) and steel claws (yellow cat with yellow raccoons) formed a powerful deterrent!
The restless cats were calmed down.
Especially Scarface, whose green eyes were staring at Lin Mo's claws hanging on the young leaves, full of reluctance and fear.
It can feel that this "similar"
It's true!
That ferocity is worse than that of a hungry beast!
The chaotic scene was temporarily suppressed.
Lin Mo knew that deterrence alone was not enough, he had to give carrots immediately!
He slowly retracted his paws, but his posture remained tense, his eyes scanned the cats, and his voice became slightly "gentle"
